name: Mali National Tier III Data Center (SMTD-SA / AGETIC)
developer: Societe Malienne de Transmission et de Diffusion (SMTD-SA), with AGETIC and Huawei involvement
notes: National Tier III data center in Bamako inaugurated on 2026-01-31. Reported as intended to support public cloud, data sovereignty and government digital services. No public MW capacity found.

name: Afribone Bamako Data Center / Colocation Facility
notes: Afribone advertises data center and hosting services in Bamako, including colocation-style hosting/virtualization and security measures. Third-party listings identify an Afribone DC Bamako MALI facility. No public MW capacity found.
